decisions.reason: Linking the homepage Services button to the Services page does not change the page's individual-service pricing content or selection behavior.
The homepage Pricing button destination does not change the one-time pricing model or the visibility of monthly and annual tabs.
The mobile pricing-table request is a separate clause already represented in this candidate; changing homepage button destinations does not alter the table interaction.
Changing homepage button destinations does not alter the hero image emphasis, overlay color, opacity, or visual effect.
The mobile hover-animation request is a separate clause already represented in this candidate; homepage button navigation does not change animation behavior.
Making the homepage Services button lead to the Services page does not change the requirement for representative service imagery.
The homepage Gallery button destination does not modify the gallery's category tabs or optional photography area.
Linking to the Pricing page does not change package count, square-footage ranges, pricing values, or their presentation.
The homepage page-link change neither resumes nor modifies the deferred instant quote calculator or its calculation rules.
Directing a homepage button to the Gallery page does not change the gallery's interactive scrolling behavior or the separately reported gallery glitch.
Homepage button destinations do not alter the site's image-focused presentation style.
Correcting homepage link destinations does not necessarily change responsive layout behavior on desktop, tablet, or mobile.
